title: My first boss looked like a mannequin that only swung while standing still. Here's the rework after 3 HP tiers
author: Final_Huckleberry408
selftext:
GORGO is the first boss of GRAYFALL, my co-op HD-2D beat'em up



So I had Claude rework him around one idea: the fight should get meaner as he gets hurt. At full HP he's a foreman, one swing and a breath. Below 70% he loses patience and attacks in bursts of two, with a fake-out jump and a chain that drags him forward. Below 40% it's bursts of three ending in a long tired pause, plus a ground drag that leaves a trail of embers and a triple jump.



Everything visual is generated by Python, no drawing program. 



What still bugs me: I haven't tested the fight with 6 players yet, and I'm pretty sure it falls apart there. For people who've made co-op bosses, how do you scale a boss for 1 vs 6 players without just multiplying HP?
